अ॑थ or अ॑था (or Ved. अ॑था), ind. (probably fr. pronom. base अ) an auspicious and inceptive particle (not easily expressed in English),
 now; then; moreover; rather; certainly; but; else; what? how else? &c.

अ॑थ or अ॑था (or Ved. अ॑था), ind. (probably fr. pronom. base अ) an auspicious and inceptive particle (not easily expressed in English),
 now; then; moreover; rather; certainly; but; else; what? how else? &c.
अथ—किम् ind. how else? what else? certainly, assuredly, sure enough.
अथ—किमु ind. how much more
so much the more.
अथ—च ind. moreover, and likewise.
अथ—तु ind. but, on the contrary.
अथ—वा ind. or rather.
अथ—वापि ind. or, rather.
अथातस् ind. now.
अथानन्तरम् ind. now.
अथापि ind. so much the more
moreover
therefore
thus.
अथरि॑, इस् or अथरी॑, f. (said to be fr. √ अत्, to go, or fr. an obsolete √ अथ्), flame [Gmn.; ‘the point of an arrow or of a lance’, NBD.; ‘finger’, Naigh.], RV. iv, 6, 8.
अथरि॑, इस् or अथरी॑, f. (said to be fr. √ अत्, to go, or fr. an obsolete √ अथ्), flame [Gmn.; ‘the point of an arrow or of a lance’, NBD.; ‘finger’, Naigh.], RV. iv, 6, 8.
अथरी॑ (accord. to some) an elephant, RV. iv, 6, 8.
1. अथर्य [VS.] and अथर्यू॑ [RV. vii, 1, 1], mfn. flickering, lambent.
2. अथर्य Nom. P. अथर्यति, to move tremulously, flicker, Naigh.
1. अथर्य [VS.] and अथर्यू॑ [RV. vii, 1, 1], mfn. flickering, lambent.
अ॑थर्वन् m. (said to be fr. an obsolete word अथर्, fire), a priest who has to do with fire and Soma

N. of the priest who is said to have been the first to institute the worship of fire and offer Soma and prayers (he is represented as a Prajāpati, as Brahmā's eldest son, as the first learner and earliest teacher of the Brahma-vidyā, as the author of the Atharva-veda, as identical with Aṅgiras, as the father of Agni, &c.)
N. of Śiva, Vasiṣṭha [Kir. x, 10], Soma, Prāṇa
अ॑थर्वन् m. n. (आ, अ) the fourth or Atharva-veda (said to have been composed by Atharvan, and consisting chiefly of formulas and spells intended to counteract diseases and calamities)
अ॑थर्वन् m. pl. (अ॑थर्वाणस्). descendants of Atharvan, often coupled with those of Aṅgiras and Bhṛgu
pl. the hymns of the Atharva-veda.
1. अथर्व (in comp. for अथर्वन्).
2. अथर्व m. N. of Brahmā's eldest son (to whom he revealed the Brahma-vidyā), MuṇḍUp.
अथर्व—भूत m. pl. ‘who have become Atharvans’, N. of the twelve Maharṣis.
अथर्व—व॑त् ind. like Atharvan or his descendants, RV.
अथर्व—विद् m. one versed in the Atharva-veda (a qualification essential to the special class of priests called Brahmans).
अथर्व—वेद m. N. of the fourth Veda (see above).
अथर्व—शिखा f. N. of an Upaniṣad.
अथर्व—शिरस् n. id.
N. of a kind of brick, TBr.
अथर्व—शिरस् m. N. of Mahāpuruṣa.
अथर्व—हृदय n. N. of a Pariśiṣṭa.
अथर्वाङ्गिर॑स् m. a member of the sacerdotal race or class called अथर्वाङ्गिरसस्, m. pl., i.e. the descendants of Atharvan and of Aṅgiras, the hymns of the Atharva-veda,
अथर्वाङ्गिरस mfn. connected with the sacerdotal class called Atharvāṅgiras
अथर्वाङ्गिरस अम् n. the work or office of the Atharvāṅgiras
अथर्वाङ्गिरस आः m. pl. the hymns of the Atharva-veda.
अथर्वण m. N. of Śiva.
अथर्वाण n. the Atharva-veda or the ritual of it, MBh.
आथर्वण॑ mf(ई॑)n. (Pāṇ. iv, 3, 133) originating from or belonging or relating to Atharvan or the Atharvans, AV.; Āp. &c.
आथर्वण॑ (अ॑स्), m. a descendant of Atharvan or the Atharvans (as Dadhyác), RV.; AV.; TS. v, &c.
a priest or Brahman whose ritual is comprised in the Atharva-veda, a conjurer, MBh. v, 1391, &c.
the Atharva-veda, ChUp. &c.
N. of a text belonging to the Atharvaveda Comm. on KātyŚr.
आथर्वण॑ (अम्), n. N. of different Sāmans
= अथर्वणां समूहः, (g. भिक्षादि, q.v.)
an apartment (in which the sacrificer is informed by the officiating Brāhman of the happy termination of the sacrifice), L.
अथर्वणि, इस्, better आथर्वणि, m. a Brāhman versed in the Atharva veda, L., a family priest, L.
अथर्वणि, इस्, better आथर्वणि, m. a Brāhman versed in the Atharva veda, L., a family priest, L.
अथर्वाण—विद् m. one versed in that ritual.
अथर्वी॑ f. [‘female priest’, Gmn.; BR.] pierced by the point (of an arrow or of a lance), RV. i, 112, 10
cf. अथरि.
(accord. to some) fiery (cf. विश्पला below), RV. i, 112, 10.
आथर्वण—रहस्य n. N. of wk.
आथर्वण—शिरस् n. N. of an Upaniṣad (belonging to the Atharva-veda).
आथर्वणिक mf(ई)n. belonging or relating to the Atharva-veda, Daś. &c.
आथर्वणिक m. (Pāṇ. iv, 3, 133; vi, 4, 174; g. वसन्तादि, q.v.) a Brāhman versed in the Atharva veda.
आथर्वणीय-रुद्रोपनिषद् f. N. of an Upaniṣad.
आथर्विक mfn. relating to the Atharva-veda, VāyuP. ii.
